test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 7 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If a boy goes from his home to his school at a speed of 40 km/h, he reaches 10 minutes early. If he goes at a speed of 35 km/h, he reaches 5 minutes late. What will be the time taken for the journey at a speed of 35 km/h?
solution:
**Given:**

Speed of boy 40 km/h and 35 km/h respectively.

**Formula used: **

Speed = Distance/Time

**Calculation: **

The ratio of the speed of boy,

S₁ ∶ S₂ = 40 ∶ 35

⇒ S1 ∶ S2 = 8 ∶ 7

The ratio of time,

t₁ ∶ t₂ = 7 ∶ 8

According to the question,

the difference in the speed change

1 unit = 15 minutes

⇒ 8 units = 120 minutes

**∴ The time taken for the journey at a speed of 35 km/h 120 minutes. **
